{{Top|leg}}
A '''baffled drive''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Engine/Legends|engine]] that used chemical thrust as a propellant. Chemical thrust engines were an old concept for spacedrives, and left a superheated trail in its wake that could be easily picked up by [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] for [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] after the ship had made its transit. Baffled drives overcame this problem by using supercooled [[Gas/Legends|gases]]<ref name="PP">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref> like [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]]<ref name="SAV">''[[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|Scum and Villany]]''</ref> and thrust modules to scatter the exhaust to leave as small a wake as possible. While inefficient, vessels using baffled drives were harder to detect. [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili StarDrive]] manufactured the [[WhisperThrust Engine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="PP" />
